sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists five Benson Selectboard members: Brad Barrett (Chair), Benjamin Bartholomew, Daryl Burlett, Guy Charlton (Vice Chair), and James Pritchard.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Heidi Chandler as Town Clerk of Benson.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact information spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Heidi Chandler as Town Clerk of Benson.

Town of Benson official website (bensonvermont.gov): 'Town Office Notes' post (December 30, 2025) is signed 'Heidi Chandler, Clerk/Treasurer.' Benson combines the clerk and treasurer offices in one elected position.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Heidi Chandler as Town Treasurer of Benson.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town treasurer contact information spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Heidi Chandler as Town Treasurer of Benson.

Town of Benson official website (bensonvermont.gov): 'Town Office Notes' post (December 30, 2025) is signed 'Heidi Chandler, Clerk/Treasurer.' Benson combines the clerk and treasurer offices in one elected position.
17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a moderator at annual town meeting.

Town of Benson official website (bensonvermont.gov): the 'Benson Open Seats 2025' post (December 28, 2024) lists John Hill as the incumbent Moderator, and the 'Offices and Candidates for March 3, 2026' post (February 20, 2026) lists him as the candidate for the office. The town publishes no results for the March 2026 town meeting, so no holder is recorded.

Town of Benson official website (bensonvermont.gov): the Municipal Administration page names 'Lois Trenn, Gina Parker and Ed Peltier' as the town's listers. The 'Benson Open Seats 2025' post marks Gina Parker's lister seat '(Appointed)'; her membership is recorded as appointed, the others as elected.
17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of auditors at annual town meeting.

Town of Benson official website (bensonvermont.gov): the 'Benson Open Seats 2025' post lists Robert Bizek as the incumbent auditor for the seat filled in 2025, and the February 2026 candidates post lists Lynn Bowen as the candidate for the seat filled in 2026. The town publishes no town-meeting results, so no holders are recorded.

Town of Benson official website (bensonvermont.gov): the 'Benson Open Seats 2025' post lists Barbara Burlett as the incumbent Delinquent Tax Collector, and the February 2026 candidates post lists her as the candidate for the office (17 V.S.A. section 2651d). The town publishes no results for the March 2026 town meeting, so no holder is recorded.

Town of Benson official website (bensonvermont.gov): the town's open-seats posts show one Trustee of Public Funds seat filled each year for a three-year term (incumbents Jayme Van Noort Purdy in 2024 and Brad Barrett in 2025; Carrie Lafond was the candidate in 2026). The town publishes no town-meeting results, so no holders are recorded.
17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a grand juror at annual town meeting.
Town of Benson official website (bensonvermont.gov): lists no grand juror, and no other official source publishes the holder.
17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a town agent to prosecute and defend suits at annual town meeting.
Town of Benson official website (bensonvermont.gov): lists no town agent, and no other official source publishes the holder.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Benson justices of the peace.

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Benson justices of the peace for the 2025-2026 term (Lynn Bowen, John Hill, Lauren Mohan, Ed Peltier, Eric L. Shaw); they are the winners of the November 5, 2024 election for the office. The listing publishes no vote totals and no party designations for justices of the peace.
